description: The whole of graph.ttl and graph.nq for a two-node dataset, byte for byte, where the Bundle's `bundle.license_prose` is `CC0-1.0`, not the Content Use Terms identifier, so the publisher has not adopted the Content Use Terms and `schema:usageInfo` carries the prose licence in their place, on the Bundle node and on the item node (AGSC-06-18). The rest is the Turtle profile: the constant seven-line prefix block of AGSC-05-10, one blank line between subject blocks and one trailing LF, subjects and predicates in IRI code-point order, `schema:license` and `schema:usageInfo` as plain literals (AGSC-05-31 form (c)), and each N-Quads line a quad whose graph name is the Bundle IRI (AGSC-04-15). Expected values are derived by hand from the rule text.
